*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/.generate_options.py
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+DATA = "data/crashes.parquet"
+WEEKDAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+daily = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT crash_date, strftime(crash_date, '%A') AS weekday, count(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY crash_date
+    ORDER BY crash_date
+    """,
+    [DATA],
+).df()
+daily["year"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["crash_date"]).dt.year
+
+overall = (
+    daily.groupby("weekday", as_index=False)["crashes"].sum()
+    .set_index("weekday").reindex(WEEKDAYS).reset_index()
+)
+overall["share_percent"] = overall["crashes"] / overall["crashes"].sum() * 100
+overall.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+bars = ax.bar(overall["weekday"], overall["crashes"] / 1000, color="#4472C4")
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{v:,.0f}k" for v in overall["crashes"] / 1000], padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.set(title="NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025", ylabel="Crashes (thousands)", xlabel="Day of week")
+ax.set_ylim(0, overall["crashes"].max() / 1000 * 1.13)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+overall.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+bars = ax.bar(overall["weekday"], overall["share_percent"], color="#2A9D8F")
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{v:.2f}%" for v in overall["share_percent"]], padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.set(title="Share of all NYC crashes by weekday, 2013–2025", ylabel="Share of crashes (%)", xlabel="Day of week")
+ax.set_ylim(0, overall["share_percent"].max() * 1.15)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+yearly = (
+    daily.groupby(["year", "weekday"], as_index=False)["crashes"].sum()
+)
+yearly["annual_total"] = yearly.groupby("year")["crashes"].transform("sum")
+yearly["share_percent"] = yearly["crashes"] / yearly["annual_total"] * 100
+yearly["weekday"] = pd.Categorical(yearly["weekday"], categories=WEEKDAYS, ordered=True)
+yearly = yearly.sort_values(["year", "weekday"])
+yearly.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
+for day in WEEKDAYS:
+    series = yearly[yearly["weekday"] == day]
+    ax.plot(series["year"], series["share_percent"], marker="o", markersize=3, linewidth=1.7, label=day)
+ax.set(title="Weekday share of annual NYC crash totals, 2013–2025", ylabel="Share of that year's crashes (%)", xlabel="Year")
+ax.set_xticks(list(range(2013, 2026, 2)))
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.legend(ncol=4, frameon=False, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.13))
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+max_by_year = yearly.loc[yearly.groupby("year")["share_percent"].idxmax()]
+min_by_year = yearly.loc[yearly.groupby("year")["share_percent"].idxmin()]
+top_day = overall.loc[overall["crashes"].idxmax()]
+low_day = overall.loc[overall["crashes"].idxmin()]
+friday_max_years = int((max_by_year["weekday"].astype(str) == "Friday").sum())
+sunday_min_years = int((min_by_year["weekday"].astype(str) == "Sunday").sum())
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Crash-record count",
+            "denominator": "None; absolute number of crash records",
+            "grouping": "Weekday across 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Bar chart",
+            "reason": "Absolute counts directly answer how many recorded crashes fell on each weekday over the full period.",
+            "probability": 0.45,
+            "answer": f"Friday had the most recorded crashes ({int(top_day['crashes']):,}), while Sunday had the fewest ({int(low_day['crashes']):,}) among {int(overall['crashes'].sum()):,} crashes dated 2013–2025.",
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Share of all crash records (percent)",
+            "denominator": "All crash records dated 2013–2025",
+            "grouping": "Weekday across 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Bar chart",
+            "reason": "Percentages make each weekday's contribution to the full-period total easy to compare as a composition.",
+            "probability": 0.25,
+            "answer": f"Friday accounted for {top_day['share_percent']:.2f}% of all recorded crashes, the largest weekday share, while Sunday accounted for {low_day['share_percent']:.2f}%, the smallest.",
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 3,
+            "metric": "Share of that year's crash records (percent)",
+            "denominator": "All crash records in the same calendar year",
+            "grouping": "Year and weekday, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Multi-series line chart",
+            "reason": "Year-specific shares show whether the weekday mix was consistent or changed across the study period.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": f"Friday had the largest share of crashes in {friday_max_years} of the 13 years, and Sunday had the smallest share in {sunday_min_years} years; the lines show the annual weekday mix rather than cumulative volume.",
+        },
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
*** End Patch

ANSWER: By total crash count, Friday had the most recorded crashes (338,800) and Sunday the fewest (257,544) from 2013 through 2025.  
By share of all crashes in that period, Friday accounted for the largest share (15.89%) and Sunday the smallest (12.08%).  
By annual share, Friday had the largest weekday share in all 13 years, while Sunday had the smallest in all 13 years.
